changes.title: Station item previews
items: At the treehouse's dressing stations, the picture boxes show what you're choosing: a top or a bag on its own, her head for hair, glasses and earrings, her legs for shoes, her back for cloaks and scarves, and her hat on the mirror's Hat card.

changes.title: Red floor
items: While the ground is still getting ready (near the coast, or just after sailing), it now shows each area's own floor colour instead of a red floor.

changes.title: Hat step skip
items: When there is no hat lying anywhere to put on, the morning pointer moves on to the next step instead of waiting.

changes.title: Treehouse crown seethrough
items: The treehouse oak's leaves now clear round the witch the way the forest's do: the see-through circle and her silhouette when she's under or behind them, and the canopy cut-away on the ground.
